headline: Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf Erupt in Heavy Fighting
war_summary: Since the prior dispatch, frontlines have fractured dramatically across the north and east. In the Weathered Expanse, bitter fighting claimed over 2,600 casualties in two hours and produced six fresh base conversions, leaving the sector split between four Colonial positions, three Warden redoubts, and two neutral zones. Farther east on the Stlican Shelf, clashes around Briar prompted eight base exchanges in two hours, yet the line remains tilted eight-to-one in Colonial hands despite heavy losses on both sides. Across Callahan's Passage, the Warden garrison completed its recovery, securing all ten regional strongholds as base turnovers ceased despite two thousand new casualties. Meanwhile, northern combat abruptly flared in Kuura Strand, logging eight base shifts within two hours before Wardens re-established control over all six sites. On the Nevish Line, four recent base transitions chipped away at defenses, leaving five bases in Warden hands, one under Colonial banners, and two reduced to no-man's-land. Mooring County continues to absorb hundreds of casualties without territorial alteration, while Palantine Berm has settled into complete quietude.
